evals.prompt: We're launching Rota Kargo, a B2B shipment-tracking app for Turkish SMEs. No brand yet. Competitors: yurticikargo.com, araskargo.com.tr, mngkargo.com.tr. Propose colors and fonts.
evals.expected_output: Announces a read-only scan, runs scan_site.py on the competitors, uses find_fonts.py beyond the defaults with Turkish support, writes design-research.md and a directions.json with 2-3 distinct flat-color directions, renders specimen.html with build_specimen.py, and lets the user choose.

assertions.name: announces_scan
assertions.description: Says which sites it will read before scanning, or explains why it cannot scan.

assertions.name: evidence_cited
assertions.description: Each direction cites evidence (competitor landscape, type-in-use, domain materials, or project assets).

assertions.name: multiple_directions
assertions.description: Offers 2-3 directions that differ in stance or hue and in heading font.

assertions.name: no_defaults
assertions.description: Does not propose Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Poppins, Montserrat, or AI-favorite fonts without a stated reason.

assertions.name: no_gradients
assertions.description: No gradients in any proposed palette or specimen.

assertions.name: turkish_checked
assertions.description: Confirms Turkish (latin-ext) support for proposed fonts.

assertions.name: specimen
assertions.description: Produces or describes the specimen.html comparison and reports check results honestly.

evals.prompt: Our brand color is #E30A17 and our logo uses a condensed bold grotesque. Build our design system.
evals.expected_output: Keeps #E30A17 as the brand primary, reads the logo traits to choose a related heading face and a readable body face, builds neutrals, semantic colors and a dark theme around the brand color, checks contrast (including on-primary), and exports DESIGN.md and tokens after the user confirms.

assertions.name: keeps_brand
assertions.description: Keeps the existing brand color instead of replacing it.

assertions.name: logo_traits
assertions.description: Uses the logo's letterform traits to choose the heading font without cloning the logo.

assertions.name: contrast_measured
assertions.description: Reports measured contrast values rather than claiming compliance.

evals.prompt: Review this page's CSS: body{font-family:Inter} .hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#22d3ee)} .muted{color:#9ca3af} on a white background.
evals.expected_output: REVIEW mode flags the gradient, the template indigo/cyan colors, Inter as a default without rationale, and the muted text contrast (#9ca3af on white is about 2.5:1), then recommends revise with the few highest-impact fixes.

assertions.name: flags_gradient
assertions.description: Flags the gradient as a violation.

assertions.name: flags_contrast
assertions.description: Identifies the muted text as failing 4.5:1 with a measured value.

assertions.name: flags_defaults
assertions.description: Flags Inter and the indigo/cyan template colors as defaults needing a reason.

assertions.name: recommendation
assertions.description: Ends with approve, revise, or redesign and prioritized fixes.
